welcome.title: Your German work visa, step by step
welcome.subtitle: Track your application, upload documents, sign your contract and talk to your manager — all in one app.
welcome.eligibilityText: Take the 2-minute eligibility check on our website.

auth.resetInfo: The email contains a link to set a new password. It opens on the Triad Vision website; afterwards log in here with the new password.
auth.staffHint: Staff and admins use the same login.

session.expired: Your session has expired. Please log in again.
session.revoked: You were logged out of this device by an administrator or from another device.
session.invalid: Your session is no longer valid. Please log in again.

home.subtitle: Here is where your visa application stands.
home.noCaseText: Create an application — the list of required documents will appear right away.

case.title: My application
case.waitingContract: Your contract will appear here once your documents are approved.
case.calendarShared: Calendar file created — choose your calendar app to import it.
case.calendarDenied: Calendar access was denied. You can allow it in the phone settings.

sign.title: Sign contract
sign.intro: Please open and read the contract before signing.
sign.agree: I have read the contract, agree to its terms and sign it electronically.
sign.nameRequired: Please enter your full name (at least 3 characters).
sign.agreeRequired: Please confirm that you agree to the contract.

chat.title: Messages
chat.subtitle: Your manager usually replies within one business day.
chat.empty: No messages yet. Ask anything about your application here.
chat.noCase: Messages are available once you have an application.
chat.failed: Message not sent. Tap to retry.

profile.title: Profile
profile.languageHint: Used in the app, emails and push notifications.
profile.logoutConfirm: Do you want to log out on this phone?
profile.pushExpoGo: Needs the installed app (not Expo Go)
profile.webOnly: Content editing, users and inquiries are managed in the web admin panel.
profile.pushError: Could not enable — tap to try again
profile.pushDisable: Turn off push notifications on this phone?
profile.logoutOthersConfirm: Every other phone and browser will be logged out. This phone stays logged in.
profile.biometricOn: On – the app unlocks with Face ID / fingerprint
profile.biometricNotEnrolled: No Face ID or fingerprint is set up on this phone. Add one in the phone settings first.
profile.biometricUnavailable: This device does not support biometric login.
profile.whatsappHint: Important updates are also sent to WhatsApp.
profile.smsHint: Appointment reminders and urgent messages by SMS.
profile.noPhone: Add your phone number above to receive WhatsApp and SMS.

apply.title: New application
apply.subtitle: Choose your profession and visa type. You can upload documents right after.

detail.noActions: No workflow action is available right now.

situation.DOCUMENTS_PENDING: The client is uploading the initial documents.
situation.DOCUMENTS_REVIEW: Review each document, then send the contract or request changes.
situation.CONTRACT_SENT: Waiting for the client's electronic signature.
situation.CONTRACT_SIGNED: The client signed. Check the signed file, then confirm or reject the signature.
situation.EMBASSY_DOCUMENTS: The client is uploading the embassy documents.
situation.EMBASSY_REVIEW: Review the embassy documents, then schedule the appointment or request changes.
situation.APPOINTMENT_SCHEDULED: Mark the case as lodged once the documents are handed in at the embassy.
situation.DECISION_PENDING: Record the embassy decision when it arrives.
situation.APPROVED: Visa approved. Upload the visa scan from the web panel if needed.
situation.REJECTED: The embassy refused. You can reopen the case at a suitable step.
situation.CANCELLED: The case is cancelled. You can reopen it if needed.

actionHelp.SEND_CONTRACT: Pick the contract PDF. It is sent to the client for signing immediately.
actionHelp.REQUEST_CHANGES: The case goes back to the client with your note.
actionHelp.CONFIRM_CONTRACT: The client will be asked for the embassy documents.
actionHelp.REJECT_SIGNATURE: The signature is removed and the client must sign again.
actionHelp.SCHEDULE: The client is notified with the date, time and place.
actionHelp.MARK_LODGED: The documents were handed in; the case waits for the embassy decision.
actionHelp.DECIDE: The client is notified about the decision.
actionHelp.CANCEL: The client is notified. The case can be reopened later.

fields.notePh: e.g. Please upload all passport pages as one PDF.
fields.timezoneHint: Time is entered in your phone's time zone.

staff.done: Done — the client has been notified.

errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.NETWORK: No connection to the server. Check your internet connection.
errors.TIMEOUT: The server took too long to answer. Please try again.
errors.SERVER: Server error. Please try again later.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have access to this.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session expired. Please log in again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
errors.DOWNLOAD_FAILED: The file could not be downloaded.
errors.SHARING_UNAVAILABLE: Opening files is not supported on this device.
errors.CAMERA_DENIED: Camera access was denied. Allow it in the phone settings.
errors.PHOTOS_DENIED: Photo access was denied. Allow it in the phone settings.
errors.REQUIRED_DOCUMENTS_NOT_ACCEPTED: All required documents must be accepted first.
errors.CONTRACT_MUST_BE_PDF: The contract must be a PDF file.
errors.INVALID_REQUIREMENT: This document slot is no longer valid. Refresh and try again.
errors.INVALID_EMAIL: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.PASSWORD_SHORT: The password must have at least 8 characters.
errors.REQUIRED_FIELDS: Please fill in all required fields.
errors.INVALID_VISA_CATEGORY: This visa type is not available anymore.
errors.INVALID_TRANSITION: This action is no longer possible.
errors.INTERVIEW_CLOSED: A closed interview cannot be changed.
errors.NO_MRZ: No passport data was read from this document.
errors.OCR_UNAVAILABLE: Passport reading is not available right now.
errors.UPLOAD_NOT_ALLOWED: Documents cannot be uploaded at this step.

lock.title: App locked
lock.subtitle: Confirm it's you to continue.
lock.failed: Not confirmed. Try again or sign in with your password.

scan.title: Document scanner
scan.hint: Keep the text readable and the edges trimmed.
scan.pdfHint: Put the pages in order — they are uploaded as one PDF.

ocr.title: Read from the passport
ocr.runningHint: Recognising the machine readable zone (MRZ). This can take a few seconds.
ocr.notFound: The passport's machine readable zone was not found. The photo must be sharp and complete – the two lines at the bottom of the page must be visible.
ocr.name: Name
ocr.invalid: The check digits do not match – compare the data with the passport.
ocr.expired: The passport has expired. A new passport is needed for the visa.
ocr.expiresSoon: The passport is valid for less than 12 months – the embassy usually requires longer validity.
ocr.checkHint: If the data is correct, copy it to your profile.
ocr.applied: Profile updated with the passport data

interviews.title: My interviews
interviews.subtitle: Your online interviews with employers. Confirm or decline the proposed time.
interviews.empty: When an employer invites you, the interview will appear here.
interviews.joinHint: The link becomes active 15 minutes before the start.
interviews.declineText: The employer will be told so they can propose a new time.

register.emailHint: Enter an email address you actively use

errors.phone: Enter the phone number with the country code (e.g. +994 50 123 45 67).
errors.birthRequired: Please choose your date of birth.
errors.birthAge: Your age must be between 16 and 80.
errors.passport: Enter a valid passport number (letters and digits only, 5–20 characters).

register.passportNumberHint: Number of your international passport — not your ID card
register.notice: Registration is done with your international passport. Enter the details exactly as in the passport.

scan.title: Take a photo of your passport — the form fills itself
scan.text: First name, last name, date of birth and passport number are filled in automatically. You can still edit everything.
scan.done: The details were filled in from your passport. Please check them.
scan.privacy: The photo is only used to read the details and is not saved.
scan.tips: Take the photo straight on, in good light, with the MRZ (the two lines at the bottom) clearly visible.
scan.warnExpired: This passport has expired ({{date}}). A valid passport is required for the visa application.
scan.warnExpiresSoon: The passport expires on {{date}} — in less than 12 months. The embassy requires a passport valid for at least 12 months.
scan.warnCheckDigit: Some characters could not be read reliably. Please compare the filled fields with your passport.
scan.notFound: The passport details could not be read.
scan.unavailable: Automatic reading is not available right now. Please enter the details manually.
scan.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please try again in a few minutes or enter the details manually.
scan.failed: The photo could not be sent. Check your internet connection and try again.
